failure_summary.description: Explicit qualifiers or identifiers were omitted, placed in the wrong fields, or mapped to the wrong geographic level or canonical value.
Compound requests omitted a distinct requested operation or deliverable.
A related but mismatched endpoint was chosen instead of one matching the requested output or account scope.
The response was malformed JSON or failed to represent parameters in the active contract's required nested shape.

patch.reasoning: Action reconciliation, endpoint choice, and schema mapping are already covered by the skill, so repeating those rules would add little. The batch includes two failures in constructing the response itself; make the existing answer-contract check more concrete about nested parameter objects and validating the complete wrapped payload.

edits.content: - Reproduce the active answer contract literally at every nesting level: each parameter item must use the specified shape, including both its name and value when required—not a list of bare names or values. Construct one top-level JSON list of complete call objects, then check delimiters and validate the entire wrapped payload as JSON.
